_doc: Members of a class are treated as SUBSTANTIALLY IDENTICAL (IRC §1091 / Rev. Rul. 2008-5). Cross-class pairs (e.g. VOO vs VTI, S&P-500 vs total-market) are the court-tested DISTINCTION the harvest loop trades on. Conservative by construction: adding a ticker to a class only ever makes the guard STRICTER. This mapping is a TAX JUDGMENT, reviewable + revisable without a deploy — never hard-code equivalence in code. T-317/T-319.
